description: Get every bookmaker's current decimal prices for one event's main markets: head to head (with the draw where the sport has one), line (handicap) and the main total. Each price shows the bookmaker and when SockOdds saw it. Set all_markets to true to include every priced market, such as halves and props (this costs more objects: one for the event plus one per priced outcome).

all_markets.description: Include every priced market, not just head to head, line and total

bookmakers.description: Optional comma separated bookmaker keys, at most 20, for example sportsbet,tab

event_id.description: Event ID from find_event, for example ev_000ckk0nc1tg

name: get_odds
title: Get odds for an event
